algorithm: Original MIT BC4 endpoint/index fitting, R block then G block
quality: default: both palette modes at per-channel extrema
mip_policy: floor halve each axis, area-average unit vectors, renormalize every mip, replicate edge texels to 4x4 blocks
indices: 16 row-major 3-bit indices, least significant bits first, little endian
dds_contract: DX10 header and DXGI_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM (83) are written by texelith-io::encode_dds_bc5; slice header-free bytes at mip offsets
maximum_quality: CPU reference +/-4 extrema search, exact rational integer GPU distance; equal-error endpoints may differ from CPU f32 ties
maximum_quality_cpu_bound: Summed decoded RG squared error in 8-bit code units <= CPU reference SSE + 1.0; checked on gradients, 23 seeded blocks and two smooth/steep blocks
